1475b59390d62b3e.description: FOUNDING DEVOPS & MLOPS ENGINEER (GRAPH AI PLATFORM) Company: ContexQ Location: Singapore / Remote At ContexQ, we are fundamentally reshaping the emerging landscape of Contextual Decision Intelligence. We leverage cutting-edge Symbolic AI, Graph AI, Vector Search, and Agentic frameworks to resolve billions of entities and relationships in real-time, uncovering hidden insights that revolutionize how global enterprises handle fraud detection, financial crime (AML), and risk management. We are an ambitious, fast-moving startup taking on massive enterprise big data and distributed graph challenges, and we are looking for a Founding DevOps & MLOps Engineer to serve as the backbone of our platform architecture. This is not a traditional corporate maintenance role. We are looking for an elite systems engineer with the DNA of an architect—someone who can orchestrate complex Kubernetes clusters, optimize distributed Spark and Graph Neural Network (GNN) workloads, and build production-grade GitOps pipelines for autonomous agentic reasoning modules. You will not just be managing servers; you will be operationalizing the next generation of explainable AI (XAI) for high-stakes industries. THE MISSION As our Founding DevOps & MLOps Engineer, you will lead the hands-on technical operationalization of a distributed graph computing solution that processes billions of records. You will bridge the gap between complex AI/ML research and rock-solid enterprise infrastructure. Your ultimate metric is system resilience, ultra-low latency, and deployment velocity. You will build high-throughput CI/CD pipelines, automate Lakehouse operations, and create the seamless technical foundation that makes ContexQ's AI platform blisteringly fast, rock-solid, and enterprise-ready. WHAT YOU WILL DO • End-to-End CI/CD & GitOps Automation: Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub commits, Terraform, and Kubernetes to automate testing and deployment of microservices across Dev, Test, and Production environments. Establish GitOps workflows to deploy and version-control agentic reasoning modules. • Lakehouse & DataOps Engineering: Streamline the ingestion and processing of billions of records by automating Spark-based pipelines, service meshes, and blocking strategies (e.g., LSH). Operationalize incremental resolution supporting both real-time streaming (Kafka/Flink) and batch modes. • MLOps & Graph AI Operationalization: Productionize Graph Neural Networks (GraphSAGE), semantic resolution models (Sentence-BERT), and risk scoring models at scale. Integrate SHAP, LIME, and real-time observability to monitor model drift, API latency, and pipeline health. • Security & Enterprise Compliance: Integrate security scanning and automated compliance checks directly into the pipeline to meet stringent banking compliance standards for financial crime and fraud detection. • Infrastructure Optimization: Optimize Docker image layering, Kubernetes resource allocation, and API load balancing to ensure high-performance execution of distributed graph algorithms with minimal latency. WHO YOU ARE • Distributed Systems Expert: Master's in Computer Science or Data Engineering with 5+ years of hands-on experience in distributed computing, large-scale Apache Spark workloads, and Kubernetes container orchestration. • Cloud-Native & IaC Fluent: Highly proficient in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm) and cloud-native microservices architecture. • DataOps & MLOps Practitioner: Proven track record in streamlining CI/CD for big data pipelines, deploying ML models, and working with modern Lakehouse technologies (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and search engines (Elasticsearch). • A Systems Builder & Owner: You thrive in high-stakes, fast-paced environments. You take full ownership of reliability, performance, and scalability without needing a massive ops team behind you. COMPENSATION & THE CONTEXQ UPSIDE We are explicitly looking for top-tier engineering talent who wants to bet on themselves, act as true owners, and build foundational technology. We structure compensation to heavily reward dedication and long-term impact. In exchange for your technical mastery and leadership, we offer competitive compensation, significant early-stage foundational equity, a high-impact remote-first culture, and a Long Term Incentive plan featuring a 75% base-salary bonus at the end of your 4th year of service. This role is designed for a builder who wants real skin in the game. If you are looking for a low-stakes corporate job, this isn't for you. If you want to solve complex distributed graph challenges and share directly in the value you create, you belong at ContexQ.

Position: Assistant Manager / Manager / Senior Manager Corporate Finance & Treasury

Qualification: CA Inter / CA / CMA

Experience: 8-15 years of relevant experience in Corporate Finance, Treasury, Banking, Fund Raising and Financial Planning.

Location: Gorakhpur

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and analytical Corporate Finance & Treasury professional to manage the organization's financial planning, banking relationships, fund raising, debt management and treasury operations.

The role will be responsible for ensuring optimum utilization of funds, managing banking and credit facilities, developing financial models, preparing CMA data and supporting the organization's overall funding and liquidity requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Corporate Finance

• Manage day-to-day corporate finance activities and financial planning.

• Analyze the company's financial position and identify funding requirements.

• Support management in financial decision-making through detailed financial analysis.

• Prepare and monitor budgets, cash-flow projections and financial forecasts.

2. Fund Raising & Debt Management

• Lead and coordinate fund raising activities through banks and financial institutions.

• Evaluate various debt and financing options based on business requirements.

• Manage existing and proposed debt facilities, including working capital and term loans.

• Prepare debt requirement analysis and debt indications for management review.

• Coordinate with lenders for sanction, renewal and enhancement of credit facilities.

• Monitor interest costs, repayment schedules, covenants and overall debt exposure.

3. Banking Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with banks, NBFCs and other financial institutions.

• Liaise with bankers for working capital limits, term loans, LC, BG and other banking facilities.

• Handle documentation, renewal and enhancement of banking limits.

• Negotiate interest rates, banking charges and other financing terms wherever possible.

4. CMA Data & Financial Analysis

• Prepare and review CMA Data for working capital and credit facility requirements.

• Analyze financial statements, ratios, cash flows and working capital cycles.

• Prepare MIS and financial reports for management and lenders.

• Ensure accuracy and timely submission of financial information to banks and financial institutions.

5. Treasury Management

• Monitor daily cash flows, fund availability and liquidity requirements.

• Ensure optimum utilization of available funds.

• Manage cash flow forecasting and fund allocation.

• Monitor bank balances, fund movements, interest costs and short-term funding requirements.

• Ensure timely servicing of interest and principal obligations.

6. Trade Finance

• Manage and coordinate trade finance activities, including Letter of Credit (LC), Bank Guarantees (BG), Buyers' Credit, Bills Discounting and other relevant facilities.

• Coordinate with banks and internal teams for trade-related documentation and transactions.

• Monitor utilization of trade finance limits and ensure timely closure/renewal.

7. Financial Modelling

• Develop and maintain financial models for business planning, funding requirements and investment decisions.

• Conduct scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis and cash-flow modelling.

• Evaluate financing options and their impact on the company's financial position.

Required Skills & Expertise

• Strong understanding of Corporate Finance and Treasury Management.

• Hands-on experience in Fund Raising and Debt Management.

• Strong exposure to Banking & Financial Institution relationships.

• Excellent knowledge of CMA Data preparation.

• Good understanding of Trade Finance, LC, BG and Working Capital facilities.

• Strong financial modelling and analytical skills.

• Good understanding of financial statements, cash flows and financial ratios.

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage multiple financial priorities.

Candidate Profile

• CA Inter / CA / CMA qualified candidates preferred.

• 8-15 years of relevant experience in corporate finance, treasury, banking or financial planning.

• Candidates with strong exposure to debt raising, banking relations, CMA, treasury and fund management will be preferred.

• Experience in dealing directly with banks, NBFCs and financial institutions is essential.

• Strong analytical, communication and negotiation skills.

Key Competencies

Corporate Finance | Fund Raising | Debt Management | Treasury Management | Banking Relations | CMA Data | Financial Modelling | Trade Finance | Working Capital Management | Cash Flow Management

14d5bf580e9d4568.description:
Arrangr | Growth Lead, Expansion & Lifecycle | REMOTE | Fixed-fee project ($12K, milestone-based) + equity tied to ARR results → founding role | https://arrangr.com
Arrangr is a scheduling platform with tens of thousands of registered users and hundreds of thousands of people reached through scheduling invitations. Calendly is the incumbent, and it's good. Our thesis: booking links make it efficient to fill your calendar, not productive. Every open slot looks identical, so your best hours go to whoever clicks first. Arrangr schedules by importance.
The opportunity: we can see which companies already have several people using Arrangr individually. Each of those is an unmonetized team. You'd build the motion that converts them (in-product surface, sequences, landing page, pilot) and handle the replies it generates: seats, admin rights, security questions. Then reactivate a large dormant base and fix acquisition.
The engagement: five milestones over roughly three months, $12K paid on milestone completion, milestones 1 and 2 contracted first. "Done" means shipped, instrumented and measured against a baseline. Equity is a defined grant tied to new ARR booked; hitting the middle tier triggers a founding title. Engineering time is limited, so you ship within existing product surfaces.
Right for you if you've run PQL-to-team expansion and reactivation against a base in the tens of thousands. Not for CRO specialists (our volume won't support the testing), paid media buyers, or anyone who wants to manage a team. There is no team. You're it.
To apply: no cover letter. Email adams@arrangr.com with three links to things you personally built, one line each on what the numbers did. Plus one answer: we can see which companies have several individual users. How would you turn that into team conversions, and have you run that motion before?
I read and reply to every one. – Adam, co-founder/CEO

As we increasingly integrate AI into our products and workflows, you will be expected to learn, adopt, and eventually champion Agentic AI tools, both to accelerate your own QA processes and to validate our upcoming GenAI features. **What You Will Do** **Core Test Automation (The Primary Focus):** * Framework Architecture: Build and scale highly maintainable automated testing frameworks from scratch for Web and Mobile (including Flutter or native apps) using modern tools like Playwright, Cypress, or Appium. * API & Backend Validation: Conduct rigorous backend testing for high-throughput REST/GraphQL APIs. Be hands-on in both coding and architecture, leading from the front.

Partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership to shape roadmaps and make high-quality trade-offs that maximise business and customer impact.

Spotting and resolving cross-team technical dependencies before they become blockers

The kind of judgment that earns trust fast – engineers follow your technical lead because you’re right, not because of your title

•

Competitive pay and benefits

Flexible work from home or office hours

Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team
